Implements factor-adjusted regularized latent regression models for
large-scale assessment and multilevel latent variable analysis. The
package provides estimation, simulation, and diagnostic tools for
FARL-type models under various conditions.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`drawPVs()`](https://yijunchenguw.github.io/FARL/reference/drawPVs.md)
  : Draw Plausible Values from a Fitted Latent Variable Model
- [`factor.analysis()`](https://yijunchenguw.github.io/FARL/reference/factor.analysis.md)
  : Factor analysis
- [`farlr_debias()`](https://yijunchenguw.github.io/FARL/reference/farlr_debias.md)
  : FARLR Debiased Estimation for Regularized Latent Regression
- [`farlr_emm()`](https://yijunchenguw.github.io/FARL/reference/farlr_emm.md)
  : FARLR EM-M Algorithm for Latent Regression with Regularization
- [`mml()`](https://yijunchenguw.github.io/FARL/reference/mml.md) : Fit
  a Latent Regression Model via the EM Algorithm
- [`sim_a1`](https://yijunchenguw.github.io/FARL/reference/sim_a1.md) :
  Simulated Dataset: 1D FARLR-Style Dichotomous Item Responses
